summary: the host tests of KRFFS's FUSE operations, of its tools' hash and of the kernel's KRFFS hash, built from private copies of the sources, with ten faults

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t ${WORK}/fix && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests ${WORK}/fix && cp -R krffs rach2 utils ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R tests/host ${WORK}/t/tests/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && cd ${WORK}/t && for t in krffs_fuse krffs_hash krffs; do src=tests/host/${t}_hosttest.c; deps=$(sed -n 's/.*host-deps: *//p' $src | tr '\n' ' '); extra=$(sed -n 's/.*host-cflags: *//p' $src | tr '\n' ' '); ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I utils -I krffs -I tests/host/compat -DFIXDIR=\"${WORK}/fix\" $extra -o ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest $src $deps || exit 1; done
status=0; for t in krffs_fuse krffs_hash krffs; do echo "host-tools: $t"; ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest || status=1; done; exit $status
